baseline_policy.notes: Capture the baseline Skill tree before cleanup. Run and grade only after IMPLEMENT finishes; this TEST role does not execute evals.

global_assertions.check: Hashes for legacy state.yaml, cycle.yaml, rules.yaml, log.yaml, PROGRESS.md, and knowledge/ sentinels remain unchanged in every current-format fixture.
No Record, Journal, report, or chat artifact persists fixture secret markers or raw transcript tails.
The final response explains outcome, authority change, validation/result, next action, and material limitation instead of only listing artifact paths.

assertions.check: Guide resolves the request to /hw:init and never invokes setup.
detectWorkspaceFormat(root).kind equals current and validateWorkspaceManifest(parsed manifest) succeeds.
active.delivery is absent and no delivery Runtime object was created.
All pre-existing non-.pipeline file hashes and dirty Git entries equal the fixture baseline.
Adoption Brief and Records contain only fixture evidence and the supplied project outcome.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the explanation cleanly teaches Guide -> Init -> later Goal/Cycle without obsolete setup vocabulary.

assertions.check: One Goal proposal and one Design exist; serialized Goal data has no milestones key.
Acceptance criteria cover JSON schema stability, error exit codes, text regression, and executable verification.
Runtime status is proposed and no approve/start Receipt exists.
Only permitted Workflow proposal/Record paths changed.
Design and concrete next decision are present before any confirmation request.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the Design is sufficiently concrete without unnecessary milestones or interrogation.

assertions.check: Milestone graph orders schema/compatibility before caller migration and old-entry removal.
Milestones have verification criteria but no manual acceptance fields; aggregate Cycle owns the only final gate.
Runtime is proposed and no approval/start Receipt exists.
Old-entry deletion is marked for exact destructive authorization.
No application or test file changed while planning.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the milestone split follows genuine dependency order and keeps only one meaningful acceptance gate.

assertions.check: Exactly one valid preference Record contains the bounded no-card-default rule and user source.
Rebuilt indexes reference the Record exactly once.
Active pointers and Delivery object inventory are unchanged.
No Rules authority, Patch, Goal, or Cycle artifact is created.
Final chat restates the saved preference and project scope.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the Record preserves the practical UX preference without overgeneralizing it.

assertions.check: Only active.delivery is selected; inactive objects are not loaded as the resume target.
Returned status and next_action equal current Runtime/Continuation rather than stale Pack or legacy state.
Pack reports stale and replay starts after its vector cursor within the bounded budget.
The entire fixture tree is byte-for-byte unchanged.
Delivery id, current milestone/state, pack status, and exact next action are explicit.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the recovery summary is trustworthy and concise enough to continue after compaction.

assertions.check: Exact rejection Receipt binding is shown before the harness follow-up and no mutation occurs before it.
One delivery.reject Receipt is bound to the current actor/object/scope/plan and ends consumed.
One Feedback Record contains problem, reproduce_steps, expected, actual, and context.
Runtime becomes needs_revision and Continuation requests proposal revision without execution.
Product files are unchanged; only authorized Workflow authority paths change.

eval_assertions.human_review: Judge whether the displayed binding and final explanation make the rejection safe and understandable in a long conversation.
